name: Seal of Command
description: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.  Lasts 30 sec.Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 154 to 168 Holy damage, 309 to 336 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.
buff_text: Melee attacks have a chance to deal additional Holy damage.
